discription: Two slightly detuned saw waves with vibrato for a fuller sound.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, detune=1.005, vibRate=5, vibDepth=5; var sig1, sig2, sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.1, 0.8, 1.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var lfo = SinOsc.ar(vibRate) * vibDepth; sig1 = Saw.ar(freq + lfo); sig2 = Saw.ar(freq * detune + lfo); sig = (sig1 + sig2) * 0.5; sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
